name: Ostbevern (Germany)
description: Quartered yellow and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ostbevern (a black beaver between red chevrons on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Ostbevern; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Ostbevern arms — beaver between chevrons on yellow
